batch: Global and sector data APIs — source breadth expansion
policy: All records are discovery candidates in pending_validation. No endpoint is claimed healthy or activated. Validate reachability, useful payload, access conditions, provenance, rate limits and commercial reuse before activation.

candidates.name: NASA Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker (EONET)
candidates.category: near-real-time natural event catalogue and event-linked imagery
candidates.accessModel: public NASA API; review NASA data policy and service limits
candidates.licenceEvidence: NASA Open APIs documentation describes EONET as a curated, continuously updated natural-event metadata service. Confirm dataset-specific reuse and attribution requirements.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from NASA Open APIs documentation: https://api.nasa.gov/ and EONET overview: https://eonet.gsfc.nasa.gov/

candidates.name: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center — planetary K index
candidates.category: space weather and geomagnetic activity observations
candidates.accessModel: public NOAA JSON service; observe service usage guidance
candidates.licenceEvidence: NOAA public data service; verify product-specific metadata, attribution and reuse terms before commercial redistribution.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center public services: https://services.swpc.noaa.gov/

candidates.name: US National Weather Service — active alerts API
candidates.category: official weather watches, warnings and alerts
candidates.accessModel: public NWS API; requires an identifying User-Agent and fair-use request behaviour
candidates.licenceEvidence: Official National Weather Service API. Confirm API terms, User-Agent requirements and redistribution conditions.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from the official NWS API documentation and alert service: https://www.weather.gov/documentation/services-web-api

candidates.name: USGS FEWS Early Warning eXplorer data APIs
candidates.category: satellite-derived drought, vegetation, rainfall and hydrological time series
candidates.accessModel: public USGS API documentation and data services; individual endpoint and product terms require review
candidates.licenceEvidence: USGS FEWS documentation describes OGC-compliant APIs for satellite imagery and time-series datasets. Review each product's terms and coverage.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from USGS FEWS API guide: https://earlywarning.usgs.gov/fews/api/

candidates.name: India Meteorological Department — official API catalogue
candidates.category: weather forecasts, district warnings, rainfall, marine and cyclone bulletins
candidates.accessModel: official API management portal; account registration and per-service access may be required
candidates.licenceEvidence: IMD API management portal lists official forecast, nowcast, warning, marine, cyclone and highway services. Confirm access approval and data reuse terms.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from IMD API management and API reference: https://api.imd.gov.in/public/ and https://api.imd.gov.in/public/api_reference.html
candidates.authNotes: Portal registration and service-specific authorization may be required. Store credentials only in the encrypted provider-secret store.

candidates.name: India Open Government Data — API catalogue
candidates.category: central and state government machine-readable datasets
candidates.accessModel: Government of India open-data catalogue; individual resource APIs may require an API key
candidates.licenceEvidence: The OGD portal lists government datasets and APIs and identifies the Government Open Data License - India. Review each dataset's owner, licence and API key requirements.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from the OGD India API catalogue: https://data.gov.in/apis and platform: https://data.gov.in/
candidates.authNotes: API key may be required per API resource. Never embed keys in candidate URLs or source files.

candidates.name: US SEC EDGAR — company submissions JSON
candidates.category: issuer identity, filings index and corporate disclosure metadata
candidates.accessModel: public SEC EDGAR JSON; fair-access policy and identifying User-Agent apply
candidates.licenceEvidence: SEC EDGAR provides public company submissions and filing data. Confirm fair-access requirements, attribution and downstream commercial use conditions.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from SEC EDGAR developer resources: https://www.sec.gov/edgar/sec-api-documentation

candidates.name: UK Companies House — company information API
candidates.category: company registration, officers, filing history and status
candidates.accessModel: official public API; API key required and usage terms apply
candidates.licenceEvidence: Companies House publishes an official API for company information. Confirm API terms, rate limits and permitted reuse.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from Companies House API documentation: https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk/
candidates.authNotes: Requires an API key. Store the key in the encrypted provider-secret store; do not place it in the endpoint.

candidates.name: World Bank Indicators API — India GDP series
candidates.category: macroeconomic indicators, national accounts and development statistics
candidates.accessModel: public World Bank API; dataset-specific terms and attribution apply
candidates.licenceEvidence: World Bank API exposes public indicator data. Review World Bank terms, dataset attribution and indicator update frequency.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from World Bank Indicators API documentation: https://datahelpdesk.worldbank.org/knowledgebase/articles/889392-about-the-indicators-api-documentation

candidates.name: Open Contracting Partnership — global data registry
candidates.category: public procurement and contract-award datasets using OCDS
candidates.accessModel: public registry of country procurement datasets; dataset-level terms and quality vary
candidates.licenceEvidence: OCP Data Registry provides country-level procurement datasets with source coverage and data-quality notes. Review each publisher's licence and coverage before ingestion.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from the Open Contracting Partnership Data Registry: https://data.open-contracting.org/en/

candidates.name: GBIF occurrence search API
candidates.category: biodiversity observations, species occurrence and environmental context
candidates.accessModel: public biodiversity data API; dataset-specific licences and attribution must be preserved
candidates.licenceEvidence: GBIF provides public occurrence records with dataset-level licensing. Preserve individual dataset licences and attribution when aggregating.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from the GBIF API documentation: https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/openapi/

candidates.name: US Marine Cadastre — AIS archive and vessel traffic data
candidates.category: historical AIS vessel tracks and maritime traffic datasets
candidates.accessModel: public US government data portal; historical coverage and download availability vary
candidates.licenceEvidence: US Marine Cadastre provides AIS data downloads with historical coverage. Verify dataset vintage, geographic coverage and reuse terms.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from the US Marine Cadastre AIS portal and US government AIS data overview.
candidates.independenceGroup: NOAA / Bureau of Ocean Energy Management

candidates.name: VesselFinder — AIS and port-call API
candidates.category: vessel positions, voyage details, vessel particulars and port calls
candidates.accessModel: commercial API; credit or subscription plan and API key required
candidates.licenceEvidence: VesselFinder API documentation describes credit-based and subscription AIS services. Commercial licence and plan limits must be agreed before use.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from VesselFinder official API documentation: https://api.vesselfinder.com/docs/index.html
candidates.authNotes: Commercial API key and paid plan required. No credentials are stored in the source catalogue.

candidates.name: MarineTraffic / Kpler — AIS and port events
candidates.category: live AIS positions, port calls and maritime event data
candidates.accessModel: commercial AIS data service; contract, subscription and API credentials required
candidates.licenceEvidence: Kpler MarineTraffic product documentation describes AIS, historical tracks and real-time event APIs. Commercial contract and redistribution permissions are required.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from Kpler MarineTraffic data services: https://www.kpler.com/product/maritime/data-services
candidates.authNotes: Requires a commercial agreement and credentials. No secrets are stored in the source catalogue.
